title: openom name model
$comment: Name/Part fragment for the canonical data model. See plan/design.data-name-mode.md. `type` and part `tag` are OPEN vocabularies (any string) — the registry is documented, not enforced. Byte-precise bounds are re-checked Rust-side (OPE-96); maxLength here is a generous code-point ceiling. The canonical schema (OPE-96) $refs the $defs below and carries the bounds_version.

uuid.$comment: opaque, random, high-entropy id (UUIDv4-class) — see design.data-model.md Addressing

position.$comment: where a particle renders relative to its part; default `prefix` when absent

value.$comment: generous, increasable per-part budget — enough for Ge'ez/Arabic/CJK

particle.$comment: separable connector (van/de/ibn/al-/'von und zu'); ignored for sort/match

borrows_from.$comment: COMPOSITION: this partial name borrows its unstated parts (the family) from that name's id — directional, acyclic

equivalent_to.$comment: EQUIVALENCE: the same name as each listed id, differently rendered — symmetric, class-forming; orthogonal to borrows_from (a name may set both)

provenance.$comment: qualifier of the equivalence relation: a co-equal `original` vs a `derived` rendering; only meaningful with equivalent_to

primary.$comment: the default known-by name — at most one per person (checked in code, not schema)
